shots.narration_dhivehi: ކުރިމަތިލުން. އެމީހުން ލިފްޓާ ދިމާއަށް ދިޔަ މަގުމަތީގައި، ފަހަތުން ބަޑީގެ ވަޒަންތަކެއް އައި.
shots.narration_english: Confrontation. On their way towards the lift, bullets came from behind.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޝްހަމް ފަސްއެނބުރި ބަލާލިއިރު، ދެ ފާރަވެރިއަކު އެމީހުންގެ ފަހަތުން ދުވަމުން އާދޭ. އެމީހުން ބޭނުންވަނީ އެންމެ ސިކުންތެއްވެސް ބޭކާރުނުކޮށް އަޝްހަމްމެން މަރާލަން.
shots.narration_english: When Ashham turned and looked back, two guards were running after them. They wanted to kill Ashham and the others without wasting a single second.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު! ރާނިޔާ ގޮވައިގެން ލިފްޓަށް ވަދޭ! އަޝްހަމް ރާނިޔާގެ ބައްޕަ ހަބީބާ ހަވާލުކުރުމަށްފަހު ތަނބެއްގެ ފަހަތަށް ޖެހި ބަޑިޖަހަން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb! Take Raniya and get into the lift! After handing Raniya's father to Habeeb, Ashham got behind a pillar and began to fire.
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޝްހަމްގެ ފުރިހަމަ އަމާޒުން ފުރަތަމަ މީހާގެ މެޔަށް ވަޒަން އަރައި ބިންމައްޗަށް ވެއްޓުނު. ދެވަނަ މީހާ ބިރުން ފާރެއްގެ ފަހަތަށް ގޮސް ފިލި.
shots.narration_english: With Ashham's perfect aim, the first man was hit in the chest and fell to the ground. The second man ran in fear behind a wall and hid.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެވަގުތު ސިސްޓަމުން ގޮވަމުންދިޔަ. ފައިވް މިނިޓްސް ރިމެއިނިންގް. އަޝްހަމް! އަވަހަށް އާދޭ!
shots.narration_english: At that moment the system kept calling out: Five minutes remaining. Ashham! Come quickly!
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު ލިފްޓުގެ ދޮރު ހިފަހައްޓައިގެން ހުރެ ހަޅޭއްލަވައިގަތް. އަޝްހަމް ފަހަތަށް ފުންމައިގެން ގޮސް ލިފްޓުގެ އެތެރެއަށް ވަން.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb shouted, holding the lift door. Ashham leapt back and got inside the lift.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ދޮރު ބެދުމާއެކު ލިފްޓު މައްޗަށް ދާން ފެށި. ބިމުގެ އަޑިން މައްޗަށް ދިޔައިރު، ބަންކަރުގެ ތިރީ ބައިތަކުގައި ކުދިކުދި ގޮވުންތައް ގޮވަން ފެށި އަޑު އިވޭ.
shots.narration_english: As the door closed, the lift began to go up. As it rose from deep underground, the sound of small explosions starting in the lower parts of the bunker could be heard.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މުޅި އިމާރާތް ތެޅެމުން ދިޔަ. ބަންދުން ވީއްލުން. ލިފްޓުގެ ދޮރު ހުޅުވުނީ ރަށުގެ އިރުމަތީ ފަރާތުގައި ހުރި ބާ ގުދަނެއްގެ ތެރެއަށް.
shots.narration_english: The whole building was shaking. Escape from the trap. The lift door opened into an old storehouse on the east side of the island.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބޭރަށް ނުކުމެވުމާއެކު، ތާޒާ ވައިރޯޅިއެއް އެމީހުންގެ މޫނުގައި ޖެހުނު. އޭރުވެސް މަޑުމަޑުން ވާރޭ ވެހެމުންދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: As soon as they got outside, a fresh breeze hit their faces. Rain was still falling gently.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެމީހުން ގުދަނުން ނުކުމެ އަތިރިމައްޗަށް ދުއްވައިގަތް ވަގުތު، ބިމުގެ އަޑިން ބާރުގަދަ ގޮވުމެއް ގޮވި.
shots.narration_english: As they came out of the storehouse and ran onto the beach, a powerful explosion went off deep underground.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބަންކަރު ހުރި ދިމާއިން ބިންގަނޑު ފަޅައިގެން ގޮސް، ދުމާއި އަލިފާންގަނޑު މައްޗަށް އެރި. މުޅި ރަށުގެ ބިންގަނޑު ގުޑައިގެން ދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: Where the bunker was, the ground split open and smoke and flames rose up. The ground of the whole island shook.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ގުދަނުގެ ފުރާޅުތައް ވިއްސައިގެން ދިޔައިރު، އަޝްހަމްމެން ވެލިގަނޑު މައްޗަށް ޖެހުނު. އަޝްހަމް އިސްއުފުލާ ބަލާލި.
shots.narration_english: As the storehouse roofs caved in, Ashham and the others were thrown onto the sand. Ashham raised his head and looked.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބަންކަރު އޮތީ އެއްކޮށް ހަލާކުވެ ވަޅުގަނޑަކަށް ވެފަ. ސެމެންތިއާއި ކުނި އެއްވެފައިވާ ބޮޑު ވަޅުގަނޑެއް. އެއްވެސް އެއްޗެއް ވަކިވާވަރެއް ނޫން.
shots.narration_english: The bunker was completely destroyed and had become a pit. A huge pit full of cement and rubble. Nothing could be told apart.

beats.new_image_reason: action change: on the sand — the hard drive is safe, they survived

beats.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, a calm dark uncluttered lower third (dark sand)

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހުރިހާ އެއްޗެއް އަޅިއަށް ވެއްޖެ. ނަމަވެސް، އަޝްހަމްގެ ޖީބުގައި އޮތް ހާޑްޑްރައިވް އޮތީ ސަލާމަތުން.
shots.narration_english: Everything had turned to ash. Yet the hard drive in Ashham's pocket was safe.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މިއީ ފައިރޫޒަށް ނޭނގޭނެ ބޮޑު ސިއްރެއް. އަހަރެމެން... އަހަރެމެން ސަލާމަތްވެއްޖެ.
shots.narration_english: This was a big secret Fairooz would not know. We... we survived.
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު ވެލިގަނޑު މަތީގައި އޮވެ ނޭވާލަމުން ބުނި. ރާނިޔާ އޭނާގެ ބައްޕަގެ ގައިގާ ބާރަށް ބައްދާލައިގެން އިނދެ ހިނިތުންވެލި.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb said, lying on the sand, breathing hard. Raniya sat hugging her father tightly and smiled.

beats.new_image_reason: framing change: Ashham stands and looks out to sea — it's not over
beats.location: Kandu-huttaa beach at night: white sand, dark calm sea, dense dark jungle of screwpine and coconut palms behind the beach
beats.mood: night: cold navy-blue darkness lit by a huge distant orange glow and rising smoke beyond the trees, light rain, embers in the sky
beats.visual: Ashham (NOT in uniform here: a plain dark-grey long-sleeved civilian shirt and dark trousers, damp and dusty) standing alone at the water's edge, dusty, looking out over the dark sea with grim determination, the orange glow and smoke behind him lighting the edge of his face
beats.camera: medium shot from the side, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, a calm dark uncluttered lower third (dark sea and sand)

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޝްހަމް ތެދުވެ ކަނޑާ ދިމާލަށް ބަލާލި. މިއީ އަދި ނިމުމެއް ނޫން. ފައިރޫޒް މިހާރު ހުންނާނީ މާލެއަށް ދާން ދަތުރުމަތީގަ.
shots.narration_english: Ashham stood up and looked towards the sea. This is not the end yet. Fairooz must be on his way to Malé now.
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ހީކުރާނީ އަހަރެމެން މިތަނުގައި މަރުވީ ކަމަށް. އަހަރެމެން ޖެހޭނީ ކުރިން މާލެއަށް ގޮސް، މި ހެކިތައް ހާމަކުރަން. ނުނިމޭ.
shots.narration_english: He'll think we died here. We have to get to Malé first and expose this evidence. To be continued.
shots.speaker: ashham
